data.action: 右手用吸管轻搅放在桌上的奶茶，左手套指节碰对面同行者的蛋糕碟边，两人衣着完整。
data.camera: medium two-shot, eye level, landscape shared table view with distinct hands
data.description: 窗边奶茶卡座里，食蜂操祈穿蜂蜜黄开衫、象牙白高领上衣和茶灰百褶中裙，保留白色蛛网手套。她右手用吸管轻搅桌上的奶茶，左手指节轻碰对面同行者的蛋糕碟边，星瞳正盯着顶上的草莓。近处托盘把两只饮料杯与蛋糕分开，背后的弧形椅背接向服务台和糕点玻璃柜，窗外遮篷压住明亮街景。右侧窗光透亮奶茶与草莓，左上店灯照亮两人的脸与手套，托盘和杯底投下清楚的柔影——「本小姐才不是想要……只是帮你分担热量而已哦♪」
data.lighting: right-side window daylight through tea and strawberry; warm shop light from the upper left on both faces
data.location: 奶茶店窗边卡座，后方服务台与玻璃糕点柜可见
data.promptProse: The strawberry on her companion's cake has caught Shokuhou Misaki's star-shaped pupils. Sitting opposite the fully clothed companion, she stirs the milk tea left on the table with her right hand while her left gloved knuckle lightly touches the cake plate rim. Her honey-yellow cardigan rests over an ivory high-neck top and a taupe skirt, with the white spider-web gloves visible. A serving tray separates the drinks from the cake in the foreground. The curved booth back opens toward the service counter and glass pastry case; the window awning shades the edge of the brighter street outside. Use a landscape medium two-shot with distinct faces and hands. Daylight from the right passes through tea and strawberry, while a warm upper-left shop lamp fills both faces. Tray and cup bases cast separate soft shadows on the table.
data.title: 食蜂操祈 · 奶茶店的午后加冕·「这块蛋糕，分你一口好了」
